request.description: Creates a purchase order only when every referenced product exists and remains active under a row lock. Missing, malformed, or inactive product IDs return 422 PRODUCT_NOT_AVAILABLE with no PO mutation.

Requires supply_chain:manage and Idempotency-Key. UTC_DATE_INCLUSIVE_V1 evaluates validity after locking configuration, supplier and certificate. Strict mode returns 422 COMPLIANCE_ERROR for missing/expired/future/revoked/wrong-type/empty-scope certificates. Inactive suppliers and explicit wrong-supplier references always fail. Success includes immutable compliance_evaluation (policy, evaluated_at, strict, supplier_id, required_types, outcome, optional reason and certificate snapshot); non-strict invalid/missing certificates record WARNING. Every new receipt rechecks; replay preserves the original decision.

Returns daily sales, average order value, low stock and compliance alerts. Compliance alerts include REVOKED certificates even before their original expiry; expired_certificates_count includes revocations. days_remaining refers to the preserved original expiry date, calculated in UTC.

Records revoked_at once under a certificate row lock; preserves valid_from and expiry_date. No body required. Subsequent certificate reads report REVOKED. A concurrent strict receipt either commits first with its historical compliance_evaluation, or fails 422 COMPLIANCE_ERROR after revocation.
Includes the original immutable compliance_evaluation for documents created after the certificate-validity upgrade. Older documents omit it; it is not recalculated from current certificate status.

Receives ordered items into inventory with inline quality check (delivered = accepted + rejected). Deterministic row locking and atomic stock increments for accepted quantity only. Validates compliance status, closes PO to RECEIVED when 100% fulfilled, posts balanced double-entry ledger journal for accepted valuation, and rolls back cleanly if inventory records or compliance fail.

Returns full Goods Receipt details including inline QC records per line item (delivered_quantity, accepted_quantity, rejected_quantity, qc_outcome, qc_reason, inspected_by, inspected_at), ledger cross-reference, and immutable compliance_evaluation. Accepted receipt lines posted after the inventory cutover include stock_movement_id (UUID); rejected-only and legacy lines without a movement omit this field. Accepted stock movements, receipt records, PO status, and ledger postings commit atomically.
